reasons.text: National Weather Service Winter Storm Warning for Weber County, until 11:00 a.m. Nov. 21.
Snow is in the Valley forecast for Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
Hard freeze: lows of 25° or colder on 7 nights, as cold as 11° Monday night.
Two wet days in a row: Thursday 98% and Friday 92%.
